history.summary: 2BR (807sqft) at Arc at Tampines, a 2014 99yr development in D18, at $1.12M / $1,388 PSF — sits in the most liquid sub-$1.2M entry band with broad HDB-upgrader appeal. No URA project data and no MRT info listed; a sound, unexciting OCR holder rather than an outperformer.
history.rating_rationale: $1,388 PSF for a 12-year-old D18 leasehold 2BR is reasonable and the $1.12M ticket sits in the deepest, most liquid Tampines price band. But no URA appreciation/median data is available (rate is a regional prior), no MRT proximity is captured in the dossier, and the score (601) / losing 158-251 arena record are middling. Tampines Regional Centre + CRL/DTL are real D18 catalysts but already largely priced.
red_flags: No URA appreciation or median PSF data (regional prior only)
No MRT distance captured — Arc at Tampines is not MRT-adjacent
catalysts: Cross Island Line + Downtown Line extension connectivity
Deep HDB-upgrader buyer pool in D18
